name: qlrisk_price_treasury_bond
title: Price a TreasuryBond
description:
Price one Treasury Bond (qlrisk TreasuryBond).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, face_value=100, coupon_pct*, frequency=semi-annual, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, issuer, position.
Example: {"maturity": "3Y", "face_value": 100, "coupon_pct": 3, "currency": "USD"} gives NPV 97.85 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
